posts.text: 🛢️ Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz; Fars said a third also caught fire. The US said it disabled a vessel in the Gulf of Oman. Reuters could not confirm the reports. #Oil #Hormuz

⚡ Russian-controlled Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost external power on Sunday after damage disconnected the Ferosplavna line, its Russian-installed management said. Backup diesel generators are running and radiation is normal, it added. #Ukraine #Nuclear

🌍 The EU and UK are nearing a deal to relink their carbon markets, which could be announced at a Nov 20 summit, Bloomberg reports. UK December permits closed Friday at £64.81/t vs €86.55 for EU benchmarks; ABN Amro sees the gap narrowing. #Carbon #Energy

⚡ China's energy investment is projected at $940bn in 2026, the most of any country, per a report cited by CCTV. The IEA sees grid spending near $140bn. Coal fell to 49.7% of power output in H1, below 50% for the first time. #Energy #China

🛢️ The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed three Houthi ballistic missiles fired at the kingdom, two toward Riyadh and one toward the Eastern province. The Houthis claim strikes on Aramco facilities. Gulf supply risk stays in focus. #Oil #Yemen

🛢️ Zero Russian diesel has reached the US under the Trump-Putin October deal; at least 3 US-bound tankers redirected. Congress's ban still stands despite a temporary OFAC waiver. Diesel near $6/gal. #Oil #Markets

📈 ECB's Lagarde says euro-zone inflation will stay elevated; headline is about twice the 2% target, core held at 2.5% in October. Deposit rate stays at 2.50%. A December 25 bp hike is possible, she says, but not certain. #ECB #Markets

📉 Berkshire Hathaway's Q3 operating profit fell 5.8% to $12.7B on weaker insurance results. It bought back a record ~$9.6B of stock, while cash and T-bills hit a record $377.4B. The cash pile points to continued caution on big deals. #Berkshire #Stocks

🇫🇷 France's public debt is ~120% of GDP; the 10-year spread over German bunds is nearly 1.6 ppt, the widest since 2011 and more than double June levels. Interest costs exceed €79bn in 2026. Eurozone funding risk stays elevated. #Eurozone #Debt

📈 China's NDRC flags weak domestic demand; retail sales rose just 1.1% in the first nine months of 2026. Zheng Shanjie met private firms as officials prep 2027 growth measures. Pressure stays on China-linked risk assets. #China #Markets

⚡ Russia hit Ukraine overnight with missiles and 172 drones, Kyiv Oblast the main target; air defence downed or jammed 4 missiles and 149 drones. Klitschko says Kyiv faces a severe energy crunch after hits on power sites. #Ukraine #Energy

🚢 Qatar proposes Iran reopen the Strait of Hormuz on day 2 of a deal: US lifts the naval blockade and frees part of $8bn frozen assets; Tehran lets IAEA visit bombed nuclear sites. Shipping risk could ease if talks hold. #Oil #Markets

📈 US stock futures rose early Monday after a losing week: S&P 500 futures +0.5%, Nasdaq-100 +0.9%, Dow +186 points. Earnings, the jobs report and the midterms are due this week, so volatility may stay elevated. #Stocks #WallStreet
